title: Cleaving Enchantment
description: Adds the Cleaving Enchantment from the Java edition Combat Snapshots!
body:
# Description
This datapack adds the Cleaving enchantment from the [Java Edition Combat Snapshots](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_Combat_Tests), after the release of 1.21.5 i realise this might be possible to make.

The pack does need you to in single player relog your world and on multiplayer, request an admin to restart your server.

The [Cleaving](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Cleaving) enchantment works identical to the one on the snapshot (_Hopefully._).
